1.name: TEXT_DUNGEONWEAPONS_00000_SHADOWHUNTER_100_010
1.description: This is it. The Emerald Weapon...

2.name: TEXT_DUNGEONWEAPONS_00000_REX_200_010
2.description: I've been expecting you, hero of Eorzea!

3.name: TEXT_DUNGEONWEAPONS_00000_REX_000_010
3.description: Look, Father! This is the power that we command!
3.translation_description: Guarda, padre! È questo il potere che controlliamo!

4.name: TEXT_DUNGEONWEAPONS_00000_CID_000_020
4.description: (-Gaius-)Target in sight. Pin it down with a salvo of missiles!
4.translation_description: (-Gaius-)Bersaglio in vista. Inchiodatelo con una salva di missili!

5.name: TEXT_DUNGEONWEAPONS_00000_ALFONSE_000_020
5.translation_description: (-Voce maschile familiare-)Minaccia rilevata. Rispondo al fuoco!
